tripType: One-day stopover between London and Amsterdam (depart London Oct 24 19:30, arrive Bruges 03:00 Oct 25, depart Bruges Oct 25 16:10 towards Amsterdam)

accommodation.name: N/A - Stopover day, no overnight stay
accommodation.notes: NO accommodation in Bruges - confirmed. This is a one-day stopover between London (Oct 21-24) and Amsterdam - arriving overnight from London (03:00 Oct 25) and departing the same afternoon (16:10) towards Amsterdam. Carry-on luggage will be stored in a locker at Bruges Railway Station for the day (no hostel bag-drop needed).

arrival.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - FlixBus Route N814 (direction Amsterdam Sloterdijk), operated by FlixBus B.V. Departs London Victoria Coach Station at 19:30 on Sat Oct 24, arrives Bruges Station (Rijselstraat-Spoorwegstraat, 8200 Brugge) at 03:00 on Sun Oct 25. Seat 14D. Price: 40.98 EUR. Luggage: 1 small bag (7kg, 42x30x18cm) + 1 checked bag (20kg, 80x50x30cm).

departure.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - FlixBus Route 802 (direction Amsterdam Sloterdijk), operated by FlixBus B.V. Departs Bruges Station at 16:10 on Sun Oct 25, arrives Amsterdam Sloterdijk (Platform Zone 1, Piarcoplein, 1043 DW Amsterdam) at 20:20 (~4h10m). Seat 20C. Price: 22.48 EUR. Buses depart from the international bus stop in the Kiss & Ride zone, south side of the train station. Luggage: 1 small bag (7kg) + 1 checked bag (20kg).

days.title: Bruges Stopover: Dawn Canals, Medieval Heart & Beer (London → Bruges → Amsterdam)

timeBlocks.name: night
timeBlocks.description: Early arrival. Most of the city is closed/asleep - use this time for a quiet, atmospheric walk through the empty illuminated medieval streets and canals, or rest at a 24h cafe near the station if available.

activities.name: Overnight Bus Arrival at Bruges Station
activities.notes: Transport CONFIRMED - FlixBus Route N814 from London, arrived 03:00 (Reservation 339 293 7119, Seat 14D). See transport.arrival for full details.

activities.name: Store Carry-On in Station Locker
activities.timeRestriction: Locker access hours TBD - confirm on arrival, may need to wait until staffed hours if 03:00 arrival is too early
activities.notes: No accommodation booked in Bruges - carry-on goes straight into a station locker so you can move freely for the day. If lockers aren't accessible at 03:00, keep the bag with you during the early morning walk until lockers open.

activities.name: Night Walk: Markt Square & Canals (Empty & Illuminated)
activities.notes: Rare chance to see Bruges completely empty and illuminated at night - very different vibe from daytime crowds. Markt square, Burg square, canal bridges.

activities.name: Coffee/Rest Stop Near Station
activities.timeRestriction: Limited options open this early - may need to wait near station
activities.notes: Very few places open at this hour in Bruges. Consider resting at the station or a 24h option if found. Research/confirm options closer to travel date.

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: City wakes up - Belfry climb, waffle, and canal boat tour

activities.name: Belfry of Bruges (Belfort van Brugge)
activities.notes: Climb the 366 steps for iconic panoramic city views. UNESCO World Heritage Site. Arrive right at opening to beat crowds since time is limited today.

activities.name: Chez Albert
activities.notes: Grab your fresh, authentic Belgian waffle (gaufre). One of the best in Bruges.

activities.name: Canal Boat Tour
activities.notes: Classic 40-minute boat tour of the canals. Multiple departure points around the city. Incredibly photogenic.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Lunch and free time before heading back to catch the 16:10 FlixBus to Amsterdam

activities.name: Lunch: Moules-Frites or Flemish Stew
activities.notes: Try Moules-frites or Stoofvlees (Flemish beef stew). Avoid restaurants directly on Markt square - walk one block for better prices.

activities.name: Free Time / Explore Bruges
activities.notes: Wander freely through the medieval streets, canals, and shops before heading to the station.

timeBlocks.name: departure
timeBlocks.description: Head to the station to catch the confirmed FlixBus to Amsterdam

must_try_dishes.description: Authentic Belgian waffles - two types: Brussels waffle (light, rectangular) and Liège waffle (dense, sweet, caramelized). Best fresh from street vendors or specialty shops like Chez Albert.
Classic Belgian dish of steamed mussels (often in white wine, cream, or beer) served with crispy fries. Bruges specialty given coastal proximity.
Slow-cooked beef stew braised in Belgian beer with onions, often served with fries or bread.
World-famous pralines and truffles. Bruges has many artisanal chocolatiers. Try the caramel praliné called 'Brujas' at Galler.

drinks_and_rituals.description: Belgium produces over 1,500 different beers. In Bruges, try Brugse Zot (local blonde or brown ale from De Halve Maan), Trappist beers, or abbey ales. Served in brewery-specific glassware.
Traditional Belgian juniper spirit, predecessor to Dutch gin. Often enjoyed as a digestif.

restaurants.name: Chez Albert
restaurants.notes: Famous for fresh, authentic waffles. Recommended by locals and travel guides.

restaurants.name: De Halve Maan Brewery
restaurants.typical_cost_per_person: 14-18 EUR (brewery tour incl. beer); 4-8 EUR per beer; 15-25 EUR for pub food
restaurants.notes: Historic family brewery since 1856. Rooftop terrace with city views. Underground beer pipeline.

restaurants.name: Bar 2be / The Beer Wall
restaurants.typical_cost_per_person: 5-9 EUR per beer (some rare bottles pricier)
restaurants.notes: Famous bar with extensive Belgian beer menu. Great location by the canal. Not prioritized in the compressed stopover schedule but worth a quick stop if time allows.

tourist_traps_to_avoid: Overpriced restaurants directly on Markt square - walk one block away for better prices
Pre-packaged 'Belgian' chocolates in tourist shops - seek out artisanal chocolatiers
Waffle stands with excessive toppings marketed to tourists - authentic waffles need minimal toppings

public_transport.overview: Bruges is compact and very walkable. Most attractions are within 15-20 minute walk from center.

ticket_types.name: City bus ticket
ticket_types.notes: Rarely needed for tourists staying in city center

where_to_buy.bus_driver: Cash or card accepted on board

luggage_storage.confirmed_plan: Carry-on will be stored in a locker at Bruges Railway Station for the day - no accommodation/hostel bag-drop needed.
options: Bruges Railway Station lockers (primary plan) - confirm size/pricing on arrival, lockers may not open until early morning hours
luggage_storage.notes: No hotel/hostel involved. Since arrival is at 03:00 and station lockers may not be accessible/staffed at that hour, confirm locker access hours in advance if possible. If lockers aren't accessible immediately at 03:00, carry the bag during the early morning walk (light packing recommended) until lockers open.

practical_tips: Bruges is very compact - most attractions are within walking distance
Canal boat tours run March-November, weather permitting
Belfry tower has 366 narrow steps - not suitable for those with mobility issues
October can be rainy - carry umbrella/rain jacket
Very few places open between 03:00-06:00 - plan for a quiet walk or rest near the station
Confirm luggage storage option in advance given the early arrival
Book both legs of transport (London→Bruges and Bruges→Amsterdam) as soon as possible given the unusual overnight timing
